verdict.rationale: Warp documents its own API endpoint to create benefit deductions for a worker, which covers the payroll-deduction side. Its marketing says Warp Agent 'takes... benefits', but gives no detail on offering health plans or managing enrollments. missing for 10: documented health insurance plan offering/carrier connections, an enrollment administration workflow (open enrollment, life events), evidence that enrollments automatically sync deductions to payroll, independent or hands-on corroboration.
